genome.mutation: M1_Target_OCaml_ABCL: set target_language to ABCL. Use the OCaml ABCL/c+ runtime as the executable target.
M2_Integer_to_Symbolic_State: set state_representation to symbolic_state_names. Replace raw numeric states with Red, Yellow, and Green names.
M3_Wrap_to_Explicit_Cases: set transition_style to explicit_transition_cases. Make Red->Yellow, Yellow->Green, and Green->Red explicit.
M4_Add_Actor_Encapsulation: set encapsulation to TrafficLight_class. Keep current state and tick behavior inside a TrafficLight class/actor.
M5_Final_Z_Check: set final_formal_review to checked_against_z_specification. Accept the final program only after three formal reviews against the Z specification.
